issues: A completed triple could wait for the six-second settlement timeout when its last movement was a basket reorder.
An unclaimed level reward reopened over the next level after an application restart.
changes: Notify matched groups when a basket reorder finishes, guarded by the current generation and LogicMatched status.
Wait for actual fruit release, then open settlement without an additional fixed delay. Cancel stale-generation settlement and pair its input unlock in finally.
HUD automatic reward polling no longer owns level settlement or opens rewards while the level is finished.
On a new service session, settle already-earned saved rewards using existing claim semantics and publish only after the atomic save succeeds.
Preserve live pending rewards during in-session save-error recovery so their current Claim action can retry.

validation.review: Independent read-only review found no blocking lifecycle, generation, lock or duplicate-popup issue.
validation.limits: Offline tests execute the production service/domain/storage in isolated processes and temporary directories. Actual animation timing and phone restart behavior require device verification.
